event: FOMC minutes today, Wed 18 Nov, at 21:00 SAST. US housing starts also today (time UNVERIFIED, usually 15:30 SAST).

bullets.title: Slide deepens
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,768, down roughly 2.1% on the day and well under 3,800 (quote time UNVERIFIED, asof is approximate).

bullets.title: At support now
bullets.text: Price has reached the 3,750-3,770 support zone, after 3,780-3,800 gave way this morning.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: December quarter-point hike odds are about 94-96%, and several Fed speakers back more tightening.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is firmer at about 103.85, and the 10-year yield is about 5.10%.

bullets.title: Gulf and oil
bullets.text: Iran and Hormuz strikes keep Brent near 92-93, which feeds inflation and hike fears more than safe-haven buying.

bullets.title: Minutes tonight
bullets.text: The October FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast in either direction.
